Your first visit, step by step

Start with a 15-minute Free First Visit. Talk with Sandy about your goals. Adults can choose to train that day or choose a later day. The first visit is free. Your first class is free too — for adults, kids, and teens. Sandy confirms the class first.

Book a visit. Choose a path for who is starting.

Plan your class. Sandy confirms the class and helps you choose a pace.

If you choose to keep training:

Your first class is free. You choose if you keep training. Sandy will show you the paid plans. Each next class uses the plan you choose. Read the full guarantee terms for each paid plan.

First visit questions
What happens at the visit?
Meet Sandy for 15 minutes. See the room and talk about your goals. Adults can choose to train that day or pick a later day. A parent or guardian stays with a child or teen.
What do I wear?
Do I need to be in shape?
Need to change your visit?

Have more questions about beginner safety, kids ages, or what to wear? Browse all Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu FAQs →

"A welcoming community with no big egos. That's rare in any martial art." - Adam M.

Adults: choose how to start

Meet Sandy for 15 minutes. Talk about your goals. Adults can choose to train that day or choose a later day. Sandy confirms the class before you train.

For a visit, wear your day clothes. To train, wear clean sports clothes. Follow the class plan Sandy sends you.

Partner practice

Sparring is live practice with a partner. You can choose to try it on day one. Sandy matches the partner and pace. You can pause or end a round at any time.

Your choice: The Sandy Challenge

Try a timed round with Sandy. A belt holds his arms at his sides. He uses movement to defend. You both agree on rules first. Either of you can say "pause" to end the round. Sandy releases the belt when the round ends. You choose if you take part.

Sandy confirms your class first. Complete your waiver before you train.
